answer: Every claim climbs the beacon of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the jade re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on deterministic state transitions verified by pseudo-random validator committees. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. By the thread of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a pragmatic engineering phrasing, concise declarative statements register, it stays short.
